messages:
Anya (PM): Heads-up: ACME asked for a shortburst pilot. They need predictable tail latency for ~30-90s events but don't want a long reserved contract. Need to align on scope for an MVP and explicit launch gates.
Samir (Eng): Clarify: by predictable tail latency do they mean P95 on token generation, or end-to-end request latency? Also what's the concurrency shape?
Ken (Solutions): They care about chat UX. Example from their SRE: 200 concurrent chat sessions for ~45s during promos. Want P95 token latency <300ms for first 64 tokens. End-to-end matters too, but token P95 is our current SLO target.
Anya (PM): Proposal: pilot = small baseline reservation + burst credit pool. Soft SLA: when credits available we aim for stated P95; when exhausted we fall back to best-effort and notify. Pilot should include shadowing and a two-week observation window.
Liz (SRE): Operational constraints: autoscale prewarm must be explicit. If we promise tail latency during a 60s spike, we need either prewarmed capacity or KV/prefix cache that avoids cold KVs. Otherwise we risk loud SLO breaches.
Samir (Eng): I can add a tenant_soft autoscale mode. Rough config prototype:
```
autoscale_mode: tenant_soft
prewarm_seconds: 18
burst_window_seconds: 60
reserve_headroom_pct: 12
cooldown_seconds: 30
```
Prewarm ~= 18-20s seems like a reasonable tradeoff for pilot.
Marta (CS): From ACME: pilot must have an upfront usage cap and a transparent estimator so they don't get surprised on billing. They'll accept pilot credits (monthly cap) instead of a committed ARR.
Ken (Solutions): For billing: define credits/minute per vCPU-equivalent. Keep carryover off for pilot. Also create a simple estimator: X credits == ~Y minutes of burst at Z concurrency.
Liz (SRE): Telemetry needed before pilot: token_latency_p95, cold_start_rate, prewarm_success_rate, burst_credit_consumption, model_fallback_count. Alerts: token_latency_p95 > 350ms for 5m -> page. Also alert when credit balance < 15% and again at 5%.
Samir (Eng): Implementation checklist: API flag to enable pilot on tenant, runtime switch for tenant_soft, burst credit ledger + rate limiter, tagging of telemetry. ETA: 2 sprints to get a staging prototype + stress harness.
Anya (PM): Launch gates for pilot: console dashboards + alerts, autoscale + prewarm enabled, customer-facing pilot SLA text (soft guarantee + rollback), ops playbook, billing estimator + cap, staging dry-run completed.
ACME POC: We'll want a dry-run/dress rehearsal in staging with your load script. Also need an outage playbook and contact list.
Samir (Eng): I'll add a k6-based spike script that simulates 200 conc sessions for 45s and an internal harness to replay traces. Will include an option to ramp sessions and vary token lengths.
Liz (SRE): Ops playbook notes: if prewarm fails and P95 spikes, fallback = route to compatible lower-memory model variant or shed burst beyond baseline with a clear signal to customer. Also emit an incident draft template.
Marta (CS): I'll draft the one-page pilot agreement: objectives, success criteria (<=300ms P95 for 2/3 peak tests), billing cap, rollback terms, and contact points.
Ken (Solutions): I'll coordinate demo + dry-run with ACME and prepare a runbook for them.
Samir (Eng): I'll open PRs for API flag and runtime changes and add an example config in the docs repo.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: runtime/pilot-soft-burst -> staging. Build 0.4.2 -> started.
Anya (PM): Decisions: pilot config = tenant_soft, prewarm 18s, burst window 60s, pilot credits billing with cap, launch gates as listed. Actions: Samir -> prototype + stress harness; Liz -> dashboards + alerts + playbook; Marta -> agreement + comms; Ken -> demo coordination; Anya -> draft SLA + internal checklist. Reconvene after staging dry-run. :thumbsup:
